name: Art in Nature: Sculpture Park Serfaus
titel: Kunst in der Natur: Skulpturenpark Serfaus
beschreibung: The sculpture park at Schönjoch blends contemporary art with the high alpine landscape. International artists showcase their works along a 3-kilometre circular trail at an altitude of 2,400 metres. The opening features an exhibition vernissage, artist talks, and wine tasting at the mountain station.
kurzbeschreibung: Contemporary sculptures along an art trail at 2,400 metres altitude – opening reception with mountain panorama.
